// diagnostic

E1308

`run`'s parameter isn't a CLI-derived type

What

`run`'s parameter isn't a CLI-derived type

Why

A typed `fn run(args: T)` entry only works when `T` is a `#CLI`-derived program struct.

Fix

Mark the program struct `#CLI`, or use a direct scalar-parameter `fn run` entry.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1308: tests/ui/retired_cli_marker.stderr.

Error [E0927]: `#Cli` is retired
  --> tests/ui/retired_cli_marker.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | #Cli struct Args {
    | ^^^^
 Why: The applied-rule registry owns retired spellings and replacements
 Fix: Write `#CLI`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0927

Error [E1308]: `run`'s parameter isn't a CLI-derived type
  --> tests/ui/retired_cli_marker.jet:5:14
    |
  5 | fn run(args: Args) {
    |              ^^^^
 Why: A typed `fn run(args: T)` entry only works when `T` is a `#[CLI]`-derived program struct.
 Fix: Mark the program struct `#[CLI]` (or `#CLI(Standard)` for the standard pack)
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1308
